name: Antelopus Selan Energy Ltd (formerly Selan Exploration Technology)

summary: Oil & gas exploration & production company (Bakrol, Lohar, Karjisan fields in Gujarat, since 1985). Source sheet's Saurabh curator (referring to it as 'Antelopus Selan Energy,' now confirmed as the actual current listed name) cited a turnaround/execution story with strong YoY/QoQ sales/PBT growth and production ramp.
fundamentals_table: +27% (Rs 89.61 Cr) - PARTLY due to an accounting change (reduced amortization by Rs 17.76 Cr)
FY26 avg sales +14% to 1,355 boepd; Q4 avg 1,760 boepd; 7 new wells planned by FY27

fundamentals_narrative: Real, verifiable production growth (+14% boepd, accelerating further in Q4) and healthy ROCE/ROE support the turnaround narrative. One important caveat not in the source sheet: a meaningful part of the FY26 profit growth (27%) came from an accounting change (reduced amortization), not purely operational improvement - the underlying operational story (production ramp, new wells) is still genuinely positive, but the headline profit number should be read with that adjustment in mind.
technical_read: Not independently verified this pass; source sheet notes the stock 'held from lower levels' by the curator.
sentiment_summary: Source sheet's own framing (turnaround/execution story, held from lower levels) is corroborated by real production and revenue growth data.
bse_notes: Company name change (Selan Exploration Technology to Antelopus Selan Energy) confirmed and resolved; no red flag surfaced beyond the amortization-accounting caveat noted above.
bull_case: Real, accelerating production growth (+14% FY26, Q4 run-rate even higher) with 7 new wells planned
Debt-free, established oil & gas operator with decades of field experience
bear_case: A meaningful portion of FY26 profit growth was accounting-driven (amortization change), not purely operational - the true underlying profit growth is more modest than the 27% headline
Oil & gas E&P is inherently commodity-price and geology-dependent
Small-scale operator relative to the broader energy sector
market_cap_tier: Smallcap (~Rs 2,755-2,782 Cr) - genuine headroom with a real, if partly accounting-flattered, turnaround story.
verdict_headline: Genuine production turnaround, but read the profit growth headline with the accounting caveat in mind
verdict_reasoning: Production growth (boepd) is the cleaner, more trustworthy signal than the headline profit growth figure
New well additions (7 by FY27) give visibility into continued production growth
Worth tracking whether profit growth excluding the accounting change remains positive
